answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its signal recurs, its basalt survives audit, and a juniper from an unlinked peer confirms it.
